# Stacy

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010)</sub>
- **Role:** teacher  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)</sub>
- **Titles:** Miss  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010)</sub>

## Appearance

Miss Stacy is a young woman with lovely fair curly hair and fascinating eyes. She dresses beautifully and wears notable sleeve puffs.

_Sources: [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)_

## Personality

She is bright, sympathetic, and cheerful. She possesses a natural ability to win and hold the affection of her pupils while drawing out their best qualities both mentally and morally. She handles misconduct with gentle understanding rather than harshness.

_Sources: [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 c30 P9](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0009)_

## History

Miss Muriel Stacy was hired by the school trustees as the first female teacher in Avonlea. Upon her arrival, she introduced innovative teaching methods, including morning and evening physical exercises, biweekly Friday recitation afternoons, and field days to study nature in the woods. When she caught Anne Shirley reading a storybook during history class, she addressed the deceit privately and gently, winning Anne's deep respect and devotion. She organized the Queen's class to prepare ambitious students for the Entrance examinations. After teaching in Avonlea for two years, her term concluded at the end of June, leaving her students tearful upon her departure. She advised students like Anne Shirley to pursue Second Year work at the Academy to complete a First Class license in a single year.

_Sources: [v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 c30 P9](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0009), [v1 c30 P28](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0028), [v1 c30 P29](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0029), [v1 c31 P10](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0010), [v1 c32 P0](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0000), [v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011)_
